# 1 Enoch Chapter 41 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 41:2 — "mansions" vs. "homes"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "mansions of-the-elect" | Traditional; Ge'ez mawāʿel = dwelling places, mansions |
| LOGOS | "mansions of the elect" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "homes of the elect" | More accessible English |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Mansions of the elect" (LOGOS). "Mansions" preserves the heavenly palace imagery and connects to John 14:2 ("In my Father's house are many mansions"), which may draw on this tradition.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 41:3–4 — "chambers" vs. "storehouses"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "closed-chambers" | Literal; Ge'ez ʾagmert = sealed room |
| LOGOS | "sealed chambers" | Formal equivalent |
| PNEUMA | "sealed storehouses" | Emphasizes function over structure |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Sealed chambers" (LOGOS). The term in Ge'ez refers to the physical compartment, not merely its function as storage. "Storehouses" projects a granary metaphor.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 41:7 — "rest not" vs. "never stop"

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "give-thanks and-praise and-rest-not" | Literal |
| LOGOS | "give thanks and praise and rest not" | Formal; preserves inversion |
| PNEUMA | "never stop giving thanks and praise" | Natural word order |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** "Give thanks and praise and rest not" (LOGOS). The inversion echoes liturgical language; "rest not" connects to the "those who sleep not" motif throughout the Parables.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

**Total disagreements: 3**
